implementation_identity: official timesfm PyPI 2.0.2 package (TimesFM_2p5_200M_torch + timesfm/utils/xreg_lib.py — the official 2.5 implementation; PyPI 3.0.x tracks TimesFM 3.0 and is NOT used), frozen google/timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch checkpoint
paper_reference: Das et al. A decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting. ICML 2024 (arXiv:2310.10688)
model_card: https://huggingface.co/google/timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch (TimesFM 2.5 version note: 200M pytorch checkpoint, fused-QKV update)

weights.sha256: see weights/weight_identities.json in the run worktree (recorded at download, 2026-10-23)

input_mapping.history_values.price: un-standardized once via frozen train target mean/std -> 72h raw RRP context; outputs raw RRP
input_mapping.history_calendar+future_calendar: dynamic_numerical_covariates cal_0..cal_9, each [96] = history fit span + horizon
input_mapping.unmapped_reason: dynamic XReg covariates need values over the 72h fit span AND 24 legal future values; demand future exists only as differently-standardized forecast vintages (splicing rejected); remaining blocks are future-only
input_mapping.scope_declaration: input_scope=restricted_price_target_calendar_dynamic_gas_static_incontext_xreg; NOT an equal-input comparison to full-1465-column models

xreg_fit.fits_on: each origin's own legal 72h price history at prediction time (in-context labels; NOT the train split; NOT 'no fitting')
xreg_fit.method: BatchedInContextXRegLinear least squares, ridge=0.0, per-input target normalization, one_hot drop=None, max_rows_per_col=0 (no subsampling)
xreg_fit.order: xreg_mode='xreg + timesfm': covariate regression fitted on the origin context -> horizon covariate effect forecast -> TimesFM forecasts the residual -> XReg effect added back
xreg_fit.quantile_effect: the XReg shift is added equally to every native channel
xreg_fit.backcast: return_backcast=True required by the official XReg path

output_quantiles.q05_q95: not native; no interpolation to common tails is performed
output_quantiles.table: P (point_only); point = native median channel + XReg (the library point return); native mean channel exists and is NOT used
output_quantiles.auxiliary: native 10 channels exported per cell to auxiliary_quantiles.npz

forecast_config.infer_is_positive_reason: NEM RRP takes negative values; leaving the default on would clamp native outputs to >=0 on origins whose 72h window happens to be nonnegative (asymmetric hidden truncation); disabled via the official flag

context_policy.label_use: in-context XReg fit on each origin's own legal history only; no train/selection/calibration labels
context_policy.test_labels: never visible to the adapter; scorer-only

randomness.seed_controls: nothing; frozen weights, deterministic kernels and deterministic least-squares fit given hardware

differences_from_paper: paper benchmarks are not NEM prices; 2.5 has its own model-card evaluation; we claim no benchmark reproduction; covariates restricted to legally mappable shared-cache fields
sources_checked: timesfm 2.0.2 installed source: timesfm/timesfm_2p5/timesfm_2p5_base.py, timesfm_2p5_torch.py, timesfm/utils/xreg_lib.py
